description: This file defines a Java interface 'CustomerOptionValueService' that provides methods for managing customer option values, including listing by store, saving or updating, and retrieving by code, in the context of a sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueService
classes.description: A Java interface extending the generic service, defining methods to manage 'CustomerOptionValue' entities, including listing by store and language, saving or updating, and retrieving by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a CustomerOptionValue entity in the database.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue by store and option value code.
